geographicScope.description: Ethiopia — Zawditu and Tafari regency within its existing editorial historical interval; office/capital is an institution of that entity, not evidence about every mapped polygon.

evidence.note: LOC body describes Zawditu as empress after Iyasu deposition and dates her death to April 1930. The 1917–1929 bounded interval excludes accession/death uncertainty and makes no claim about sole effective authority.

evidence.note: LOC body identifies Tafari as regent and heir, distinct from the empress; discusses continuing regency, influence of Habte Giorgis until 1926, and the 1928 negus title. Emperor Haile Selassie title is not projected before 1930.

absenceOfEvidence: Institutional framework already sourced and retained. Capital and currency intervals require dedicated evidence; neither is inferred from modern Ethiopia.
